info.name: Admin - Merchant & Payout Methods
info.description:
Admin endpoints for merchant creation and payout method management.

All endpoints require Admin JWT token.

request.description:
Creates a merchant with APPROVED status instantly. Also creates a default store (APPROVED).

**Required:** full_name, phone, password, business_name, business_address, district, thana, carrybee_city_id, carrybee_zone_id, carrybee_area_id

**Optional:** email, secondary_number, area, full_address

response.name: 201 - Success

request.description:
Sets this method as the default payout method. Previous default is auto-unset.

Only VERIFIED methods can be set as default.

No request body needed.

response.name: 200 - Success

request.description:
Permanently deletes a payout method.

No request body needed.

Paginated payout transaction history for a merchant.

**Query params:** page (default 1), limit (default 10)

response.name: 200 - Success

request.description:
Verifies a payout method that was added by the merchant (changes status from PENDING to VERIFIED).

This endpoint is on the /merchants controller (not /admin), but requires ADMIN role.

No request body needed.
